paper.title_en: Long lived QNM for multiple black holes
paper.abstract_en: We provide a rigorous definition of quasinormal modes (QNM) for the Majumdar--Papapetrou spacetimes with multiple extremal black holes. For certain configurations, the trapped set of the null geodesic flow contains stable (elliptic) orbits. We analyze this phenomenon in the case of two black holes of equal mass and show that it produces QNM converging exponentially fast to the real axis. QNM for black holes have been extensively studied for $\textit{single}$ black holes and this appears to be the first $\textit{mathematical}$ result for the case of multiple black holes.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文对多黑洞 Majumdar–Papapetrou 时空的准正规模给出严格数学定义，并分析两等质量极端黑洞构型下陷俘集中稳定椭圆轨道导致 QNM 指数式趋近实轴的现象；属于广义相对论基础方向的数学严格结果，理论深度与方法严谨性信号较强，值得研究者点击进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 多黑洞情形下的长寿命准正规模
decision.abstract_zh: 我们为包含多个极端黑洞的 Majumdar–Papapetrou 时空给出了准正规模（QNM）的严格定义。对某些构型，零测地线流的陷俘集包含稳定（椭圆）轨道。我们以两个等质量黑洞的情形分析这一现象，并表明它产生指数式快速收敛到实轴的 QNM。黑洞的 QNM 已在单个黑洞情形下被广泛研究，而这似乎是多个黑洞情形下的首个数学结果。
